newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-BAGGIO DEAL STILL HANGS IN THE BALANCE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-BAGGIO DEAL STILL HANGS IN THE BALANCE.

text.p: Roberto Baggio will remain an AC Milan player for a while longer after club officials said on Wednesday they had failed to finalise a widely-forecast transfer deal with serie A rivals Bologna.
Milan had been expected to confirm Baggio's departure during an afternoon news conference at which they presented their squad for the coming season.
But club vice-president Adriano Galliani said nothing had been concluded and suggested the deal still hung in the balance.
"Nothing's changed since yesterday, we're still waiting for a reply from (Baggio's) agent," he said.
"It's true that it's a situation a little bit like that," he said, making a see-sawing gesture with his hand.
"I think he needs to find a team where he can be the playmaker and I fear that in this Milan side he would find himself sacrificed."

"He's a player who should be in a first team but here it's more difficult. I hope he finds a team where he can be the director of the orchestra but, if he can't, then we're happy to have him with us."
Galliani said on Tuesday that Milan had received several offers for Baggio, the most attractive of which was from Bologna.
Italian newspapers reported on Wednesday that the two clubs had settled on a transfer fee and personal terms remained the only stumbling block.
